notes: The suffix of kullam and the finite verb yippelu both answer to the one subject pronoun they, and the chapter must read that shape one way: JOS.8.4 gives the pronoun to the finite verb (be ye all ready) and leaves the suffix unrepresented. English requires a subject for were fallen while kol keeps its own all, so the subtraction test finds the verb's rendering is what fails without the pronoun. The pronoun is moved to the verb and the suffix marked unrepresented under rule 22; nothing else in the verse changes.
